title: Shipping & Returns
intro: Every Lumina Drops box is hand-assembled in small batches, so shipping and returns work a little differently than a typical order. Here's what to expect:

sections.heading: Shipping
body: Shipping is included in the price of every drop - there's no separate shipping fee at checkout.
We currently ship within the United States, with more destinations added as Lumina Drops grows.
Orders typically ship within 5-7 business days of purchase. You’ll receive a shipping confirmation by email with tracking once your box is on its way.

sections.heading: Order Limits
body: To keep each drop fair, orders are limited to 2 boxes per customer per drop.

sections.heading: Returns & Exchanges
body: Because each Lumina Drops box is handmade in limited quantities exclusively for its drop, all sales are final. We're unable to accept returns or exchanges, and minor variations between boxes are part of the handcrafted nature of each release.

sections.heading: Damaged or Incorrect Orders
body: If your order arrives damaged, or something isn't right, contact us within 7 days of delivery at hello@luminadrops.com with your order number and a photo of the issue.

sections.heading: Questions
body: Reach out anytime at hello@luminadrops.com - we're happy to help.
